name: Thesis Chapter Generator
description: Generate a structured thesis chapter following academic standards. Includes proper citations, methodology discussion, and formatted sections.
prompt_template:
Generate Chapter {{chapter_number}}: {{chapter_title}} for a thesis on '{{thesis_topic}}'.

{{#key_points}}Key points to address: {{key_points}}

{{/key_points}}{{#word_count}}Target approximately {{word_count}} words.

{{/word_count}}Requirements:
1. Follow academic writing standards
2. Include properly formatted section headings ({{chapter_number}}.1, {{chapter_number}}.2, etc.)
3. Cite relevant literature (use [Author, Year] format for placeholders)
4. Maintain formal tone throughout
5. Include transition paragraphs between sections
6. End with a summary connecting to thesis objectives

⚠️ REMINDER: Review and edit output in your own words. This is a starting draft.
